evidence_limit: Authored translation and offline behavior. Complete ARRAY chains, supplied robot models and palette exports do not establish native syntax, ABI, calibration, physical robot behavior, camera acquisition or renderer acceptance.

chained_array_indexes.normalization: Complete adjacent ARRAY bracket groups normalize to the existing comma-index access path before type/effect analysis, including grouped receivers and function results
chained_array_indexes.order: Evaluate base once and every subscript once left to right under the existing comma capture/bounds contract; assignment still captures RHS before resolving its target
chained_array_indexes.storage: Preserve one-based indexing, full flat outer rank or named component boundaries, nominal identities, concrete capacities, readonly descendants and whole-root counter/alias proofs
chained_array_indexes.boundary: No partial flat row views, ragged arrays, rank overflow, flattening or legacy chained access

kinematic_interfaces.source: JOINTPOS and POSITION/XYZWPR/XYZWPREXT source arguments and RETURN values convert once into private checked values with existing model/adapter rules; exact same-type bare storage retains references
kinematic_interfaces.context: Explicit robot, selected frames/tools and caller/root group only; inverse uses supplied current joint seed; retain width/padding, limits, CONFIG and external-axis guards
kinematic_interfaces.ownership: Detach converted values and adapter inputs, preserve prior effects and sticky abort, convert RETURN before cleanup and leave current robot state unchanged
kinematic_interfaces.observations: Value-free KINEMATIC_ARGUMENT/KINEMATIC_RETURN outcome records and source/target metadata in kinematic_interfaces; service effects propagate through routines
kinematic_interfaces.boundary: No implicit same-kind joint-width conversion, whole-array conversion, BYNAME cast, relaxed linked declaration/raw callback result or native motion/reachability equivalence

vision_palette_images.input: Optional palette on channels=1 raster: 1..256 packed RGBA entries as immutable Python bytes or canonical lowercase hex, with every 8-bit index in range; no palette inference
vision_palette_images.persistence: Retain supplied indices and palette through captures, image registers, finds and saved JSON; count both in raw per-image and combined quotas before decoding
vision_palette_images.png: 8-bit indexed color type 3, RGB PLTE and full palette-length tRNS only when any supplied alpha is nonopaque; preserve raw index rows
vision_palette_images.bmp: Expand through existing RGBA V4/BGRA encoding after complete output-size preflight, preserving colors beneath zero alpha
vision_palette_images.boundary: Legacy G/GA/RGB/RGBA bytes unchanged; no quantization, color processing, depth/proprietary formats, camera acquisition or native renderer claim

strict_mode: Future milestone; preserve legacy guards and historical semantic ledgers
